title: Switching from a Gas Hob to Electric | Batumi
heading: Gas to Electric Hob Switch in Batumi
lead: How switching from gas to electric works: wiring check, gas branch isolation, induction or electric hob installation — and what to know before the swap.
description: Can you replace a gas hob with electric in Batumi? Wiring check, gas branch isolation, induction hob installation. Full conversion in one visit.

sections.title: Why people switch from gas to electric
items: Safety: no open flame and no gas leak risk on the kitchen counter.
Induction is faster and more efficient — it heats only the cookware.
New kitchens and modules are designed for built-in electric appliances.
Easier cleaning: no grime, grates or burner knobs.

sections.title: What to check before the swap
items: Wiring: cable cross-section, breaker and a free line — induction needs capacity.
Space: module width and depth for the new panel.
Gas tap: where it is and whether it closes properly.

sections.title: How the conversion works
items: Inspection: electrics, the line, space for the panel.
Gas panel removal and tap sealing.
Electric or induction hob installation.
Connection, test run and a short briefing.

sections.title: Do you need the gas utility
items: Official branch shutoff and sealing is done by the gas supply company.
We remove the panel and seal the tap, and help you file the request.
If gas only serves the hob — the oven and boiler keep their own lines.

sections.title: Induction or classic electric
items: Induction is faster and safer but needs magnetic-base cookware.
Classic electric is cheaper and works with any pots.
The choice depends on your line and budget — we'll sort it out on site.

sections.title: DIY mistakes
items: Buying the panel before checking the wiring — the line can't run that model.
Connecting via a regular socket without a proper breaker.
Removing the gas branch without sealing the tap.

sections.title: Preparing for the technician's visit
items: Photos of the kitchen module and the old panel.
A photo of the board (breakers) — if you plan induction.
The new panel model, or at least the type: induction / classic.

items.question: Can a gas hob be replaced with electric in an apartment?
items.answer: Yes, if the line can handle the new panel's capacity. We check before you buy: cable, breaker, a free line.

items.question: Do I need permission to disconnect the gas?
items.answer: Official branch shutoff and sealing is done by the gas utility. We remove the panel and seal the tap, and help you file the request.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Usually 1–2 hours. A new dedicated line is quoted separately.
